provenance: Cold review of the ADR-033 resolver, 2026-08-24 (finding 2 of 3). wfc-2008 writes the EIN cell as 'No. 41-0449260', so the <tr> collapses to ONE normalized line: 'Delaware No. 41-0449260'. The EIN pivot takes everything before the EIN on its line and strips only whitespace, so the filer's label rides into the value. MEASURED RED: state_of_incorporation = 'Delaware No.' at 0.95. Writing the label inside the EIN cell is a standard filer convention ('No.', 'I.R.S. Employer Identification No.'), not a byte-trick -- ADR-033 §a3 recorded that the CAPTION approach got this field wrong on 37/38, and the EIN pivot inherits a new failure mode on the same field that none of the four goldens sample, because all four happen to carry a bare value in the left cell.
